question: Should OpenClaw adopt selectable quick-fix and full-change PR templates as the contributor workflow for this linked request?
rationale: The patch is technically aligned with GitHub's native template mechanism, but the remaining question is maintainer policy for how much context small-fix contributors must provide.

options.title: Adopt The Split
options.body: Land this PR after normal base/check refresh and treat the quick/full template contract as the supported contributor workflow.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Keep the PR open but ask for specific wording or CONTRIBUTING changes before accepting the workflow.

options.title: Reject The Workflow Change
options.body: Close this PR and the linked issue if maintainers prefer one default PR template despite the contributor friction.

recommendation.title: Adopt The Split
recommendation.body: Land this PR after normal base/check refresh and treat the quick/full template contract as the supported contributor workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: Template-history commits make this the strongest routing candidate for the PR-template contract decision.
